content:
incident-bot: Pager: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/chat/completions across us-east-1. p99 > 2.5s, affecting routes using Mistral-v1 and Llama-3. Incident ID INC-223456.

sam: I'm seeing the same — looks like tail worsening over last 10m. p95 ~700ms, p99 ~2.8s. A few dedicated tenants reported 504s.

oncall-bot: Automated checks: node_health=degraded on chat-pool-3, kvcache-miss-rate +18%.

jess: starting quick triage: dashboards up, running 100-request smoke against default route. will post results.

liam: scaling chat pool by +2 nodes (requested via autoscaler). ETA ~90s.

maria: temporary mitigation: adding 5m squelch for low-volume routes under /experimental/* to reduce pager noise while we stabilize. Applying now.

sam: can we enable model-level fallbacks for non-enterprise traffic? prefer switching to mistral-v1-small for default tier if p99 > 2s.

kevin: rolling fallback policy applied for header X-Client-Type:default -> mistral-v1-small. routing change pushed to edge.

jess: smoke results: after fallback + scale, 50 requests: p95=450ms, p99=1.1s for Mistral routes. Llama-3 13B still showing 2.3s p99 on heavy tokens.

maria: created temp dashboard for per-model per-route tails: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/latency/p99-chat?from=now-1h. sharing to SRE.

sam: customer impact: 12 tenants with >30% tail increase; CS ticket opened for tenant-42 reporting 504s. linking in incident doc.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled in 40m. Next oncall: @liam.

liam: taking handoff. plan: keep autoscaler pinned to +2, monitor kv-cache memory and batching queue. will open follow-ups for alert tuning.

kevin: applied quick alert config tweak to reduce noisy pages on tiny routes. snippet pushed to alerts repo:
```
alerts:
  chat_completions_p99:
    threshold_ms: 2000
    scope: [per-route, per-model]
    min_traffic: 1000_per_5m
    squelch_seconds: 300
```

maria: also adding a derived panel that shows p99/p95 ratio per model and a traffic-weighted p99 so tiny routes don't dominate. will onboard to the console.

jess: notes for postmortem: look into kv-cache eviction spikes and batching priority inversion when many small requests arrive concurrently. assign to eng-runtime.

sam: summary of immediate mitigations: +2 nodes to chat pool, model fallback for default traffic, route squelch for experimental routes, adjusted alert thresholds and min-traffic gating. Owners: eng-runtime, eng-platform, eng-sre. Follow-up ticket: RED-INC-223456.

liam: @oncall-bot please create follow-up artifact: "alert-tuning: per-model p99 vs p95, add traffic gating and rolling window smoothing" and schedule review.

oncall-bot: Created ticket RED-INC-223456 and scheduled post-incident review for tomorrow 09:30 PT. :calendar:

jess: I'll update CS with the tenant list and mitigation timeline.

kevin: monitoring steady. keeping pager quiet for 30m.

sam: leaving thread open for notes. will capture any further regression evidence here. :white_check_mark:
